limitations: Session-authored effects and coverage metadata for GitHub issue11. It contains no original commodity observations and does not reproduce source licences or research narratives. Original qualifications, source facts and consumer inputs remain at their immutable SourceRefs.

Counts have separate denominators. The summary gives the exact expected material total and raw-fact/catalogue/user-directory/derived-packet split. Agriculture part count is read dynamically from its reviewed manifest. The230 directory records use mixed product/family/route granularity and are not an independent-upstream total.

Each listed successful effect was verified against its local immutable SourceRef, downloaded retained bytes, runtime archive SHA, receipt member hashes and complete native report. Native stored-representation reads do not independently authenticate the upstream website or establish unrestricted reuse.

Remaining agricultural unit/trade-direction fields and the silk fieldwork-date correction are explicit. No unknown field is silently filled. Qualification-only or rights-gated routes do not become data observations merely because their catalogue was retained.

The separately identified non-effect ledger is session-authored evidence metadata. It preserves every stated missing original-response/log gap. Successful successors are linked to, and counted only in, the normal effects table. Agricultural proof-file and cell locators qualify the already retained facts without adding observations.

This index is itself a later local metadata curation. Its later custody/read-back effects are not counted recursively among the prior effects indexed here. Root separately records the index own exact SourceRefs after actual publication.

Each part is a self-contained typed JSON table: schemas maps a type to field names; each record is [type,id,present_column_indexes,values]. Pair the indexes with values and map indexes through that type schema to restore the exact metadata object, including absent-vs-null distinctions. Runtime effects have separate rows keyed by run_id; materials name their put/read run IDs.
